objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle in the system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short abbreviation code for the document type used in naming convention.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document, incremented upon revision.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document within the status network (e.g., editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is considered valid, set upon release.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid, calculated from Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for which a document remains valid before requiring a validity check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The time period for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope(s) associated with the document, printable via TAG technology.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced or linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies relevant to or associated with the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas or regions where the document is applicable.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person registered as the primary author of the document, automatically set to the creator.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons assigned personal change rights on the document.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person(s) assigned to check the document for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person(s) responsible for approving and releasing the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User group assignment determining which readers may view the document.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: The original file format of the document content (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The language in which the document was originally created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and has no own release cycle, used for non-critical supplementary information.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attachment that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning, whose changes trigger a new version of the main document.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-created request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation when it has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring it to an editable state.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various capacities such as authoring, reviewing, releasing, reading, or translating documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A defined group of users used to assign authorizations, reader access, and distribution list membership for documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list maintained per document specifying user groups or persons to be informed about document releases, either by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that guides documents through approval steps including creation, review, and release with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task, documented per released version.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation action by a recipient on the distribution list actively confirming they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity within the company structure to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents and used for process-specific filing of documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents within the system.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: An IT application master data object that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user and role-specific view providing relevant document lists and information based on the user's distribution group membership.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation providing filtered results based on selection parameters and criteria for documents in the system.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The type of report such as Status Report, Search, or Acknowledgement Status Report.

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Parameters used to filter and influence evaluation results in the report.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system where documents can be visible or restricted.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A user creates a new document object in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: An author edits the content of a document using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: A user maintains or modifies the metadata and attributes of a document in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: A user selects a predefined template associated with a document type when creating a new document object.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Authorization groups and person-related permissions are assigned to a document for read and change rights control.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: An author or co-author initiates the 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) for a document.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step of the release process as the creator.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and formal correctness in the review step of the workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document in the final step of the approval workflow.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the approval workflow, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The system automatically publishes a released document making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: The system creates a new editing version of a released document when revisions are made to content, attributes, or attachments.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An author adds an additional information object to a document that is not subject to the release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An author deletes an additional information object from a document directly without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An author adds a controlled attachment to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document suggesting changes without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of assigned change proposals, notifying the creator and removing the proposal from the document display.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser or the full release team confirms the validity extension of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request for override to invalidate a released document and archive it.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow is completed, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking all rights except the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request for reactivation to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation in the workflow, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: The system physically deletes archived documents after the archive duration period has expired.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: An author maintains the distribution list for a document by assigning user groups or persons for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: send_release_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users and user groups on the distribution list when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: The system sends email requests to users on the acknowledgement distribution list upon document release to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient on the distribution list actively confirms they have taken note of a released document version via workflow.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates the released content of a document into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: A reviewer checks the translated version of a document for correctness.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the translated version of a document, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates a role-specific evaluation report with selected parameters and criteria for documents in the system.

evts.name: view_dashboard
evts.description: A user accesses the role-specific dashboard to view relevant document lists and information.
